prompt: Which country has the largest number of UNESCO World Heritage Natural Sites following the annual announcement of new additions by the committee responsible for the World Heritage List?
answer:
China has the largest number of UNESCO World Heritage **natural sites**.  

(Italy has the largest overall number of UNESCO World Heritage properties—61 after the 2025 additions—but China leads in natural sites.)
